desc:
Great Seal of King John

[Reverse] Impression of the Great Seal of King John, showing the king on horseback. Originally attached to the Articles of the Barons, the precursor to the Magna Carta, June 1215. Approx size: Diameter: 95 mm. Length at widest point of seal : 75mm.

File:Magna Carta Maquettes at Westgate Canterbury (14).JPG
desc: As of 2021, in the basement of the Westgate in Canterbury, Kent, England, were nine 19th-century six-foot plaster maquettes of lords who signed Magna Carta in 1215 AD. Westgate Museum also possesses a bag of arms and other bits which came off the maquettes. These were rescued just before the flood.
